title: TriadicFrameworks MCP — L3 Forces Unseen Lineage Schema
description: Defines the lineage schema for unseen force regimes, including causal ancestry, influence inheritance, and cross-layer cosmological lineage.
note: This schema governs lineage resolution for force-state mechanics.

schema.name: forceRegimeLineage
schema.purpose: Resolve lineage for unseen force regimes and compute inheritance metrics.

ancestorLayer.description: The cosmological layer from which the force regime inherits.

inheritanceStrength.description: Strength of lineage inheritance from the ancestor layer.

influenceAncestry.description: Degree to which unseen influence fields derive from ancestor structures.

gradientAncestry.description: Degree to which causal gradients derive from ancestor structures.

lineageCoherence.description: Coherence of lineage across unseen force regimes.

lineageContinuity.description: Continuity of lineage across cosmological layers.

reality.details: Lineage metrics computed from inheritanceStrength, influenceAncestry, and gradientAncestry.

imagination.details: Unseen force regimes inherit structural influence from fluidic ancestry.

information.details: Lineage flows qmroot → frequency → fluids → forces.
